exposure: Births in private and charitable health facilities
Type of health facility (private vs. public)
cohort: 45,327 births occurring in 81 community-based geographical clusters in four locations in Bangladesh, India and Nepal (three rural, one urban) between 2005 and 2012
finding: Caesarean section rates were higher in private and charitable facilities compared to public facilities in most locations, suggesting that the private sector may be driving increased caesarean section rates in these South Asian countries.
